stable.notes: Fix Jobs.cz microsite email autofill by adding semantic email-field detection using labels, placeholders, aria metadata and nearby field text. Diagnostics now include the email field source. Manual queue behavior and manual final Submit safety remain unchanged.

beta.notes: Desktop 2.8.1 is a full audit/polish release after the three-source migration. It corrects the Desktop header from 4 sources to 3, removes the retired source_indeed setting from existing local profiles, hides legacy Indeed vacancy/history records from Dashboard, updates source documentation, aligns runtime discovery defaults with Desktop/.env (80 per source, 12 browser-evidence jobs, 36 jobs reviewed), aligns MANUAL_CV_FALLBACK=true, removes the unused MAX_DISCOVERY_ITEMS setting, preserves real vacancy titles when detail pages expose generic headings such as 'Detail pozice', fixes cross-site dedupe priority to prefer application-capable sources then stronger evidence then Jobs.cz, and makes the Dashboard manual-queue filter follow the configured threshold instead of the stale 65–72 range. Beta GitHub releases are now marked as prereleases. Indeed remains intentionally outside Job Agent automation; only migration cleanup references remain. Manual final Submit safety is unchanged.
